source.author: lucr
source.text: quare etiam quaedam nunc artes expoliuntur, nunc etiam augescunt; nunc addita navigiis sunt multa, modo organici melicos peperere sonores, denique natura haec rerum ratioque repertast nuper, et hanc primus cum primis ipse repertus nunc ego sum in patrias qui possim vertere voces.
source.text_original: quare etiam quaedam nunc artes expoliuntur, / nunc etiam augescunt; nunc addita navigiis sunt / multa, modo organici melicos peperere sonores, / denique natura haec rerum ratioque repertast / nuper, et hanc primus cum primis ipse repertus / nunc ego sum in patrias qui possim vertere voces.
source.text_english: Wherefore also certain arts are now being polished, now even grow larger; now many things have been added to ships, now craftsmen of organs have produced melodic sounds, and finally this nature of things and this reasoning has been found only lately, and I am now myself one of the first who can turn this into native speech.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: denique natura haec rerum ratioque reperta est nuper, et hanc primus cum primis ipse repertus nunc ego sum in patrias qui possim uertere uoces.
reuse.text_original: denique natura haec rerum ratioque reperta est nuper, et hanc primus cum primis ipse repertus nunc ego sum in patrias qui possim uertere uoces.
reuse.text_english: Finally, this nature and order of things was discovered only recently, and I am now the first among the foremost who has found it and who can turn it into my native speech.
